note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a NZL 8; A06b NZL 8; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, New Zealand, 2024
sources.said: Person must be present in New Zealand (or in the Cook Islands, Niue or Tokelau) for a minimum of 1350 days during the 5 years immediately preceding the date of application and for at least 240 days in each of those 5 years and person intends to continue to reside in NZ or to enter into Crown service under the NZ government or service under an international organisation of which NZ is a member, or service in the employment of an entity resident or established in NZ. ... n.a. ... n.a.
